title: Roof-normalized Ext comparison with signed Koszul dual homology
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, r a natural number and f:Fin r -> A a Koszul-regular sequence generating I [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence, def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex]. Let L be the signed dual [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex]. There is an A-linear equivalence d:Ext^r_A(A/I,A) -> H^r(L), such that for every quasi-isomorphic integer Koszul augmentation epsilon with degree-zero quotient formula and every Ext class x there are a cochain map z:K(f)->A[-r] and a cycle y in L_r with x represented by the roof epsilon^{-1} z followed by the standard single-complex shift isomorphism, d(x)=homologyPi(y), and iCycles(y) equal to the degree -r component of z transported back to K_r. This does not assert any conormal or determinant identification.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, finite free Koszul resolution computation; generator independence via Lemma 48.15.4 (Tag 0BQY)

proof.text: Construct q_0=I.mkQ after zeroEquiv and zero higher components. Contraction in degree one is Finsupp.linearCombination f, whose range is span(range f)=I. Thus q kills the first boundary and its short complex is exact with surjective quotient map. The cokernel property gives the degree-zero homology isomorphism, and hreg makes positive-degree homology zero. Extend the resulting quasi-isomorphism along embeddingDownNat to the explicitly normalized epsilon0. This is the complete Lean proof in normalized_augmentation, adapted from the already proved exists_koszul_quotient_augmentation without importing its cyclic module. The degree-one computation specializes contractLeft_exterior_one_formula, proved for an arbitrary A-module M and linear functional phi, not only the finite free sequence functional.

Use [lem-sc-koszul-derived-dual-evaluation] for e from derived maps Q(E) -> Q(A[-r]) to signed-dual homology. Define c by Linear.homCongr using the inverse of asIso(Q(epsilon0)) as the source isomorphism and the displayed single shift as the target isomorphism. Then d=Ext.homLinearEquiv followed by c followed by e is A-linear. Any epsilon with the displayed quotient equation equals epsilon0: cancel the degree-zero source and target isomorphisms and use to_single_hom_ext.

The exterior basis [lem-weil-pbc-exterior-power-free-basis] makes E K-projective [lem-sc-bounded-above-projective-kprojective]. By [lem-pc-ring-derived-map-representative] and fullness of the homotopy quotient, lift c(x.hom) to Q(z). For every n>r the exterior basis has empty index type. Therefore every differential into dual degree n, from any degree i, is zero; specialize n=r+1 and i=r for the cycle construction. Lift the component evaluation of z into cycles using moduleCatCyclesIso.inv, and apply [lem-sc-koszul-derived-dual-evaluation] to get d(x)=homologyPi(y). Applying c.symm to Q(z)=c(x.hom) gives x.hom=inv(Q(epsilon0)) followed by Q(z) followed by the specified shift inverse. Injectivity of Ext.homLinearEquiv gives the exact roof equation. Replace epsilon by its proved equality with epsilon0. The zero-degree and zero-quotient cases are included.

proof_origin.place: B3 complete Lean proof: explicit normalized quotient augmentation and uniqueness, K-projective derived-map lifting, top cycle construction, and the fully proved augmentation-free signed-dual evaluation comparison. Repair: generalized degree-one contraction to arbitrary modules and functionals, and dual differential vanishing to all target degrees above rank.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_koszul_ext_roof_representatives
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) :
    ∃ d : Abelian.Ext (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)) (ModuleCat.of A A) r ≃ₗ[A]
        (koszulDualComplex A r f).homology r,
      ∀ (ε : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
          (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))
        [QuasiIso ε],
        (∀ x : ⋀[A]^0 (Fin r →₀ A),
          (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0
            (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).hom
            (ε.f 0 (((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := 0) rfl).inv x)) =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk I (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A) x)) →
        ∀ x : Abelian.Ext (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)) (ModuleCat.of A A) r,
          ∃ (z : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
              (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) (-(r : ℤ))).obj
                (ModuleCat.of A A))
            (y : (koszulDualComplex A r f).cycles r),
            x = (Abelian.Ext.homLinearEquiv (R := A)).symm
              (inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map ε) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map z ≫
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctors (ModuleCat A)).shiftIso
                  (r : ℤ) (-(r : ℤ)) 0 (add_neg_cancel (r : ℤ))).inv.app
                    (ModuleCat.of A A)) ∧
            d x = (koszulDualComplex A r f).homologyπ r y ∧
            (koszulDualComplex A r f).iCycles r y = (((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
      ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := r) rfl).inv ≫ z.f (-(r : ℤ)) ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (-(r : ℤ))
          (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom)
